annotations.title: Find the officials for a ZIP or address

description: Find every elected official who represents a U.S. ZIP code or street address, closest first: mayor and city council, county officials, state legislators, statewide officials, the U.S. House member and senators. Returns ids (use with get_person), offices, districts, crowdsourced ratings and page links. An address is sent to the U.S. Census geocoder only to find districts and is not stored. A ZIP gives an approximate answer (center of the ZIP). Ratings are voluntary, not a poll.
name: find_my_officials
title: Find the officials for a ZIP or address
